@echo off
echo Restoring AMD PSP (Platform Security Processor / TPM)...
Powershell -NoProfile -Command "Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId (Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName '*AMD PSP*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstanceId -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" >nul 2>&1
echo AMD PSP restored. Restart your PC.
pause
